offers.description: Reconcile available code-enforcement and complaint records for a property.

description: Paid $0.25 USD. Reconcile released code-enforcement and complaint records for one property. Use this for enforcement evidence; use build_property_intelligence_pack for a broader package. Unsupported or held jurisdictions fail before payment.

inputSchema.description: Resolve one property or place before running the requested LocalProof operation.

address.description: Street address or place to research. Include locality information when available.

city.description: Optional city used to disambiguate the address and route it to a supported LocalProof jurisdiction.

state.description: Optional state name or abbreviation. Current released jurisdictions are in California; use CA or California.

unit.description: Optional unit, suite, or apartment identifier when it is relevant to property identity.

name: localproof.check_code_enforcement
title: Check Code Enforcement
